en.title: thedotmack/claude-mem: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent
en.summary: ⭐ 114,621 | Every time you start a new coding session, your AI agent forgets everything and starts from zero. Claude-Mem solves this by running a **second agent** beside it to take notes, compress activity with AI, and inject **relevant context** back into future sessions. It works seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and many other popular coding tools.

zh.title: thedotmack/claude-mem：为每个AI编程助手提供跨会话的长效记忆
zh.summary: ⭐ 114,621 | 每次开启新的编程会话时，你的AI助手总是会失忆并从零开始。Claude-Mem 通过在旁边运行一个**观察者助手**来记录工作、用AI进行压缩，并在未来会话中自动注入**相关上下文**。它能与 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等众多主流编程工具完美配合。

en.title: Can AI Startups Survive the Personal Agent Era?
en.summary: Personal agents offer startups a chance to build value **beyond base models**, rather than just being token distributors. While big tech dominates generic AI due to massive infrastructure costs, startups can still find a **viable path forward** by focusing on deep user context and specific vertical niches.

zh.title: 创业者做 Personal Agent，有没有一线生机？
zh.summary: Personal Agent 让创业者看到了**基模之外**的生存空间，不再只是帮大厂分发 Token 的工具。虽然巨头占据绝对资源优势，但创业者依然可以通过深耕**垂直场景**和用户信任，在个人智能的浪潮中找到一线生机。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker now supports Multi-Instance GPU to cut AI inference costs
en.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports **NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG)**, allowing companies to divide a single physical GPU into independent partitions. This solves the old problem of wasting hardware on small models and eliminates the complex setup of managing Kubernetes yourself. It **improves GPU utilization**, lowers costs, and gives you hardware-level isolation for different models.

zh.title: 亚马逊 SageMaker 支持 GPU 切割，帮企业省下大笔 AI 部署开销
zh.summary: 亚马逊的 SageMaker 推理服务现在支持了英伟达的 **GPU 多实例切分技术**，能把一块完整的显卡拆成几个独立的小分区。这解决了以前小模型必须占用整张显卡、造成严重浪费的痛点，而且不用自己去折腾复杂的 Kubernetes。它能大幅**提高显存利用率**，不仅省钱，还能让多个模型互不干扰。

en.title: Capital Cools Down on World Models as Venture Market Tightens
en.summary: Venture capital investment in the **world model** sector has cooled down rapidly, shifting from a frenzy to a much tighter and more selective market. Investors are raising the bar for funding, moving away from pure concepts toward teams with **proven research and execution**, as the market seeks concrete validation beyond hype.

zh.title: 资本正在撤离“世界模型”，热钱变少且门槛抬高
zh.summary: 今年下半年以来，资本对“世界模型”的热情急速降温，拿钱变得越来越难。投资机构不再为单纯的概念买单，而是收紧钱袋子，把门槛抬得极高，只有那些具备**过硬研究积累**和技术落地的顶尖团队，才能继续获得资本的青睐。

en.title: GitHub, Google, and Siemens Share 15 Design Patterns for AI Agents
en.summary: GitHub, Google, and Siemens have pooled their knowledge to release **15 design patterns** for building reliable AI agent systems. These patterns help developers tackle common challenges like task breakdown, data validation, and multi-agent collaboration, making **AI agents** safer and more practical for real-world business tasks.

zh.title: GitHub、谷歌与西门子联合整理：AI智能体设计的15种经典模式
zh.summary: GitHub、谷歌和西门子三家巨头联合整理并公开了 **15种设计模式**，专门用来帮开发者打造更靠谱的AI智能体系统。这些模式能有效解决任务拆解、数据校验和多agent协作等难题，让 **AI智能体** 在实际工作和业务中变得更好用、更安全。

en.title: GitHub's Next Scaling Challenge: Rebuilding the Software Stack for Agent Workloads
en.summary: Jay Parikh, Microsoft's EVP of CoreAI, discusses GitHub's transition to handling massive agent workloads following its milestone of 225 million developers and 34.3 billion commits. He details **Copilot Fusion** model orchestration, cross-device agent sessions, and the necessity of measuring **AI spending** against actual business outcomes rather than raw token usage.

zh.title: GitHub的下一次扩展挑战：为智能体工作负载重构软件技术栈
zh.summary: 微软核心人工智能执行副总裁杰伊·帕里赫（Jay Parikh）在GitHub达到2.25亿开发者和343亿次提交的里程碑后，探讨了平台向处理大规模**智能体工作负载**的转型。他详细介绍了Copilot Fusion的模型编排、跨设备智能体回话，以及根据实际业务成果而非单纯的Token消耗来衡量**AI支出**的必要性。

en.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled simulation world to help robots learn better
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **ToyBlocks**, an open simulation framework designed to help robots learn how to manipulate objects more reliably. By using a controlled tabletop environment with blocks, the system **automatically generates** training data and tasks, allowing scientists to easily test robot behavior, analyze failures, and improve how machines think and move.

zh.title: ToyBlocks：一个帮机器人更好地学习和测试的模拟世界
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了一个名为 **ToyBlocks** 的开源模拟框架，旨在帮机器人更好地学习如何抓取和摆放物品。通过在一个简单的桌面方块环境中**自动生成**训练数据和任务，科学家们可以轻松测试机器人的表现、分析失败原因，并改进它们的思考与动作能力。

en.title: Wall Street suffers historic drop as AI bubble concerns mount
en.summary: The tech-heavy Nasdaq suffered its worst session in months, **wiping out** trillions in market value as worries grew over a speculative AI bubble. Fueling the drop were concerns about stricter government regulations, local pushback against **power-hungry** data centers, and doubts over whether massive AI investments will ever pay off.

zh.title: 华尔街科技股遭遇历史性暴跌，AI泡沫担忧引发市场震荡
zh.summary: 由于市场对人工智能投机泡沫的担忧加剧，纳斯达克指数遭遇数月来最大单日跌幅，数万亿美元市值**瞬间蒸发**。此次暴跌的导火索包括对政府出台更严监管的预期、民众对耗电耗水的数据中心产生**强烈抵触**，以及外界开始质疑巨额AI投资能否真正获得回报。

en.title: UK Public Bodies Stunned by Surge of AI-Generated Complaints
en.summary: The UK is facing a phenomenon called **AI clog**, where public bodies, local authorities, and MPs' offices are overwhelmed by a massive surge of AI-generated complaints and letters. While AI helps citizens write formal and lengthy requests easily, it drastically increases the **workload for human employees** who must sift through repetitive, sometimes inaccurate texts. Experts warn this drains valuable resources that could otherwise be spent on essential public services.

zh.title: 英国公共机构被AI生成的投诉信淹没
zh.summary: 英国目前正面临一种被称为**AI堵塞**的现象，公共机构、地方政府和议员办公室被大量由人工智能生成的投诉信和信件淹没。虽然AI让普通人能轻松写出长篇大论的正式信件，但也极大地增加了**人工审核的工作量**，工作人员不得不去翻看那些冗长甚至包含错误的信息。专家警告称，这消耗了本应用於公共服务的宝贵资源。

en.title: Harness-S: Training Smarter AI Agents Using Sibling Execution Environments
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **Harness-S**, a clever training method that helps AI agents learn from their mistakes by using a pool of alternative execution environments, known as sibling harnesses. Instead of relying on a single failing setup, the system steps in when initial attempts fail, rescues the process using specialized variants, and distills these successful behaviors back into a **single, robust policy**. Tests on platforms like AppWorld and SWE-Gym show that this approach significantly **boosts overall performance** compared to traditional training.

zh.title: Harness-S：利用“兄弟环境”来训练更聪明的AI智能体
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了一种名为 **Harness-S** 的巧妙训练方法，通过借助一组被称为“兄弟环境”的替代执行系统，帮助AI智能体从错误中学习。当常规的单一环境尝试失败时，系统会介入并利用特定的变体来“救场”，最后将这些成功的经验全部内化到一个**单一的模型策略**中。在 AppWorld 和 SWE-Gym 等平台的测试表明，这种方法能让AI的**整体表现**比传统训练大幅提升。

en.title: Silicon Valley Chinese Team Beats DeepSeek to Build Next-Gen Super-Agent
en.summary: DeepSeek recently proposed a super-agent architecture to solve human attention bottlenecks in AI tasks. Surprisingly, a Silicon Valley Chinese team named AFK AI built a similar **router and worker** architecture into their product Comma months ago, enabling long-term memory and **multi-task execution** through a single conversation window.

zh.title: 抢跑DeepSeek！硅谷华人把下一代Agent Harness造出来了
zh.summary: DeepSeek最近提出了超级智能体架构来解决AI任务中的人类注意力瓶颈。让人意外的是，硅谷华人团队AFK AI几个月前就在产品Comma中实现了类似的**主脑加执行者**架构，通过一个对话窗口实现了长期记忆和**多任务并行**处理。

en.title: Worktrunk: A Git Worktree CLI Built for Parallel AI Agents
en.summary: ⭐ 11,993 | Worktrunk is a command-line tool that **simplifies git worktrees** so you can easily run multiple **AI agents** at the same time without them stepping on each other's toes.

zh.title: Worktrunk：为并行 AI 代理量身定制的 Git 工作树管理工具
zh.summary: ⭐ 11,993 | Worktrunk 是一个命令行工具，它能**简化 git 工作树**的操作，让你轻松同时运行多个 **AI 代理**，而不用担心它们互相干扰。

en.title: Midterm Elections Spell Trouble for Elon Musk and AI Data Centers
en.summary: Recent U.S. midterm elections brought a wave of anti-data center sentiment, as voters and newly elected officials pushed back against the massive power-guzzling facilities. Tech giants like OpenAI are already scrambling to change their secretive tactics, even trying to rebrand data centers as **compute campuses** to appease the public. Meanwhile, Elon Musk's heavy political donations didn't pay off, leaving him facing a **political shift** in states where his companies operate.

zh.title: 中期选举结果出炉，埃隆·马斯克和AI数据中心要头疼了
zh.summary: 美国刚刚过去的中期选举刮起了一股反对数据中心的风潮，选民和新上台的官员们纷纷对这些疯狂耗电的超级大厂说不。为了平息民愤，像OpenAI这样的AI巨头已经开始服软，不仅不再搞神秘的大搞保密协议，甚至还试图把数据中心改名叫**算力园区**来重新包装。与此同时，埃隆·马斯克此前砸出去的大笔政治捐款似乎打了水漂，他的企业现在正面临着很不妙的**政治风向转变**。

en.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
en.summary: NVIDIA's open-source 6G and 5G developer tools, including Aerial and Sionna, have **surpassed 1 million downloads** worldwide. Researchers are using these platforms to build smarter wireless networks that help robots **react faster**, improve signal reception in tough conditions, and dynamically save power.

zh.title: 英伟达开源工具如何帮助研究人员打造下一代6G网络
zh.summary: 英伟达的开源6G和5G开发工具（如Aerial和Sionna）在全球的下载量已经**突破100万次**。研究人员正在利用这些平台构建更聪明的无线网络，帮助机器人**反应更快**、在恶劣环境下改善信号接收，并动态节省电力。

en.title: I tried NYT Cooking's new AI assistant: It saved my dinner, but almost ruined my cake
en.summary: NYT Cooking has added an **AI assistant** to help users customize recipes, substitute ingredients, and adjust measurements directly in the app. While it provides practical guidance and even knows when to reject absurd requests, users still need to double-check its work to avoid **baking mistakes**.

zh.title: 我试用了纽约时报烹饪频道的AI助手：它拯救了我的晚餐，却差点毁了我的蛋糕
zh.summary: 纽约时报烹饪频道在应用中新增了一个**AI助手**，帮助用户定制食谱、替换食材和调整分量。虽然它能提供实用的烹饪建议，甚至知道什么时候该拒绝离谱的请求，但用户仍需仔细核对，以免出现**烘焙失误**。
